DOB, sex, and certificate numbers stay in your private profile. They are excluded from maintenance exports and career reports. Time held describes elapsed time since issuance; it does not verify certificate validity or IA renewal status.

Install AeroLog

Your logbook, one tap or click away.

Add AeroLog to your phone, tablet, or computer. It launches with its own app icon and window.

If your browser does not show an install prompt, use the instructions below.

Android phone or tablet

Open AeroLog in Chrome. Tap the ⋮ menu, then choose Install app or Add to Home screen.

Windows or Mac computer

Open AeroLog in Chrome or Edge. Choose the install icon in the address bar, or use the browser menu to install this page as an app.

Mac with Safari

On macOS Sonoma or later, choose File → Add to Dock.

AeroLog works without an internet connection. Records and profiles are stored on this device. Use Backup & restore to protect or transfer your logbook.

Export maintenance records

Take your experience with you.

File format

This export contains clearly labeled sample records, not your personal maintenance history.

Exports include all maintenance entry fields, including references and notes. DOB, sex, and certificate numbers stay in your private profile.

Backup & restore

Your logbook belongs to you, on this device.

A complete backup includes every maintenance record and your mechanic profile, including personal and certificate details. Store it securely outside this device.

Restore or transfer a logbook

Device records are not synchronized automatically. Transfer a backup to another device and restore it there. Browser data clearing or app removal can remove local records.
